class.name: MicroGeometry
class.brief_description: Imported, independently paged cluster geometry and its simplification hierarchy.
class.description: Stores immutable derived mesh data in a native [code].mgdata[/code] file. Metadata is loaded separately from compressed geometry pages. Imported [ArrayMesh] resources retain an external reference to this file. Geometry is generated by the mesh importer.

method.name: get_content_id
method.description: Returns the content digest identifying this geometry generation.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns surface, total cluster, leaf cluster, total triangle, group, level, terminal group, page and encoded payload byte counts under [code]surfaces[/code], [code]clusters[/code], [code]leaf_clusters[/code], [code]triangles[/code], [code]groups[/code], [code]levels[/code], [code]terminal_groups[/code], [code]pages[/code], and [code]encoded_bytes[/code].
